decision: Add an Agent View tab (/agentview, AI Coding sub-nav, maturity beta) that reads the dist-agent daemon (agentd, default 127.0.0.1:7717) through a same-origin GET-only proxy at /api/agentview/[...path] with a fixed allow-list (healthz, node, nodes, build, agents, agents/{id}, agents/{id}/inventory, events, events/{id} with raw=false pinned, events/{id}/causal, projects, worktrees, stream) and requireAuth first.
rationale: The daemon pins the Host header to loopback and sends no CORS headers, so a browser on :4200 cannot read it directly; a next.config rewrite would bypass middleware.ts and ship unauthenticated. Routes that carry raw prompts, file contents or writes (prompts, conversation, diff/file, settings, auth/*, signal) are excluded until the raw-payload and control-surface decisions are taken deliberately (dist-agent docs/agentview.md).
alternatives: CORS on the daemon for the daax origin (rejected: widens the daemon's security surface for one consumer); next.config rewrite (rejected: unauthenticated); iframe only (rejected: not the same tech stack, no migration path — kept only as the Console tab while views are ported).

decision: The Agent View e2e spec drives a fixture daemon (tests/e2e/fixtures/agentview-daemon.mjs) that replays JSON recorded from dist-agent's own synthetic e2e daemon, scrubbed of host paths; the spec skips with a sentence unless AGENTVIEW_DAEMON_URL is aimed at it (playwright.config webServer.env and ci.yml set it).
rationale: The operator's real daemon on 7717 holds their real history and must not be driven by a test; a replay of the real wire is faithful without inventing shapes; a silent pass over an unrelated daemon would assert against a store the suite did not seed.
alternatives: Build the Go daemon inside daax CI (rejected for now: cross-repo toolchain coupling); hand-written stub JSON (rejected: a stand-in more capable or less informative than the real thing).
